{{Quote|It's very unsettling, I know. The first time I saw one of my Dittos, I wasn't sure whether to protect her or destroy her.|Ohali Soroc, to Han Solo, regarding Solo's biot replica|<ref name="Crucible" />}}
A [[biot]] '''replica''' of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] was created in vat inside a [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] on [[Base Prime]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Chiloon Rift/Legends|Chiloon Rift]]. The biot had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and resembled a young Han Solo. In [[45 ABY]], the real Han Solo broke into the Base Prime biot lab accompanied by the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ohali Soroc]] and the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Barduun]], and the replica Han Solo gazed at them from inside its vat. The real Han Solo regarded the replica as handsome.<ref name="Crucible" />
 
==Behind the scenes==
Han Solo's replica appeared in the [[2013]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel [[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']], written by [[Troy Denning]].<ref name="Crucible" />
